The '''2026 World Championship''' was the 31st Star Wars CCG World Championship, held by the [[Players Committee]] at the Hyatt Regency Bloomington by Mall of America in Bloomington, Minnesota, from 23 to 25 October 2026; the main event was played on 24–25 October.<ref name="sched" /><ref name="venue" /> Fifty-eight players entered, and all 58 played all eight Swiss games.<ref name="t8" /><ref name="slack1" /> [[Brian Fred]] defeated [[Justin Desai]] in the Final Confrontation with ISB Operations and Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan,<ref name="pc" /><ref name="t8" /><ref name="slack2">Players Committee Slack, #announcements, imrahil327, 25 October 2026: "Congrats to our newest World Champion, @retwin316!"</ref> a year after his Hall of Fame induction at the [[2025 World Championship]].<ref name="wc25">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/world-championship-2025-wrap-up-greg-shaw-wins-his-crown/ World Championship 2025 Wrap-Up: Greg Shaw Wins his Crown], starwarsccg.org (23 October 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012161739/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/world-championship-2025-wrap-up-greg-shaw-wins-his-crown.html Internet Archive]</ref> Fred also won the Friday team tournament with [[Phil Aasen]].<ref name="team">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=87034 Team Tournament updates (2026 World Championship)], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum</ref>

=== Top 8 bracket ===

The main event was eight Swiss games on Saturday 24 October (strength-of-schedule tiebreak), then a Top 8 of match play on Sunday with 1:15 games. Quarterfinal pairings were drawn at random, top four against bottom four; the higher seed chose which side to play first, and the bracket was re-seeded to the Day 1 standings after the quarterfinals.<ref name="sched" />

'''Day 1 seeds''': 1 [[Greg Shaw]] 8–0; 2 [[Drew Lichtenstein]] 7–1; 3 Desai 6–2; 4 [[Joe Horbey]] 6–2; 5 [[Joe Olson]] 6–2; 6 [[Dennis Reinhardt]] 6–2; 7 Fred 6–2; 8 [[Bryan Mischke]] 6–2.<ref name="t8" /> Mischke and [[Chris Wirfs]] (9th, 6–2) played a game for the eighth seat; its result was not posted, but Mischke made the Top 8 and Wirfs is listed 9th.<ref name="t8" /><ref name="pc" />

The organizer posted one game of each match; the second games and the match totals were not posted. Margins are differentials; lost piles in brackets.<ref name="t8" />
* '''Quarterfinals:''' Desai (Dark) def. Reinhardt by 20 (19–44) in the posted game, and Desai advanced. Lichtenstein (Light) def. Olson by 19 (14–31), and Lichtenstein advanced. Shaw (Dark) def. Mischke by 3 (34–33), and Shaw advanced. Horbey (Dark) def. Fred by 13 (27–35), but Fred advanced.<ref name="t8" />
* '''Semifinals''' (re-seeded): Desai (Dark) def. Lichtenstein by 20 (21–36), and Desai advanced. Shaw (Light) def. Fred by 9 (18–28), but Fred advanced; his game 2 against Shaw is in the YouTube playlist.<ref name="t8" /><ref name="yt">[https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLTVa1kgaeLRA 2026 World Championship], YouTube playlist, Star Wars CCG channel (11 videos, checked 30 October 2026)</ref>
* '''Final:''' Fred (Light) def. Desai by 5 (28–46) in game 1. Game 2 was not posted. Fred won the title.<ref name="t8" /><ref name="slack2" />

The Top 8 was streamed live on twitch.tv/swccgpc and twitch.tv/tashi_station_,<ref name="t8" /> with [[Dan Tartaglione]] and [[Garrett Larson]] as the stream team.<ref name="photo">Photo file page: [[:File:2026 World Championship Stream Team.jpg]] (from the shared "Worlds 2026 Photos & Videos" Google Drive folder)</ref> Eleven games from the weekend were posted to a YouTube playlist; the final is not among them.<ref name="yt" />

== Side events ==

* '''Team tournament''' (Friday 23 October, teams of two, one player on each side, three games, cumulative differential; 11 teams): won by The Unholy Alliance, [[Phil Aasen]] and [[Brian Fred]], with 12 points (+92) without dropping a game, for the mini obelisk trophies. Hong Kong Danger Duo were second (8, +39) and Team S&C third (8, +9).<ref name="sched" /><ref name="team" />
* '''Consolation''' (Sunday, six Swiss games, about 27 players): won by [[Patrick Johnson|Pat Johnson]], undefeated, ahead of [[Carson Stockman]], [[Sam Tashima]] and [[AJ Hatoum]].<ref name="conso">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=87038 Consolation Tournament Pairings (2026 World Championship)], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum</ref>
* '''Other events:''' a Friday Cube event ("Throdo's Cube Spectacular!") and Retro (Premiere–Death Star II) events were also scheduled; their results were not posted on the forum.<ref name="sched" /><ref name="prize">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=87025 Prize Support (2026 World Championship)], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum</ref>
* '''Holotheatre:''' Brian Fred joined deadbody and DTartagOne for a special [[Holotheatre]] episode on twitch.tv/swccgpc on Monday 2 November 2026.<ref name="slack3">Players Committee Slack, #announcements, DTartagOne, 27 October 2026 (Holotheatre announcement)</ref>
